summary: Iteration 35: Verified all webstore-related bug fixes. All 5 features tested and working correctly.

key_verifications: ✅ Login API returns valid access token
✅ Stripe Connect status shows not connected (expected for test user)
✅ Product creation with base64 images works (single and multiple images)
✅ Product update with images works - images persist after update
✅ Webstore checkout returns proper error 'Store cannot accept payments at this time' when Stripe not connected

verifications: ✅ Webstores page shows Stripe Connect gate correctly - displays 'Connect Stripe Account' message
✅ Products page has Add Product dialog with image upload functionality
✅ Image upload zone supports PNG, JPG up to 5MB with clear UI

webstore_stripe_connect_gate.description: When Stripe is not connected, users see clear message: 'Webstores require Stripe payment processing to accept customer orders. Connect your Stripe account to start selling online.'

product_image_upload.description: Products can be created and updated with base64 encoded images

product_update_images.description: Products can be updated to add/change images, changes persist in database

webstore_color_picker.description: Webstore branding with primary_color works via API
webstore_color_picker.note: Color picker UI available in create/edit dialog with data-testid='store-color-input'

webstore_checkout_error_handling.description: POST /api/stripe-connect/webstore/{store_id}/checkout returns proper error when Stripe not connected
webstore_checkout_error_handling.error_message: Store cannot accept payments at this time

seed_data_creation: Test products and webstores created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All webstore-related bug fixes verified working: 1) Stripe Connect gate shows proper message when not connected, 2) Product image upload works with base64 encoding, 3) Product update persists images, 4) Webstore color picker works via API, 5) Checkout endpoint returns clear error when Stripe not connected. The test user does NOT have Stripe Connect enabled, which is expected - webstores are properly gated.
